limitations: Isolated resource results are one query in one cold process per run, not steady-state or concurrent-load measurements. Live Uvicorn smoke is one authenticated request; RSS includes the whole app process and its other libraries. The report agent may write a privacy-minimized agent-run telemetry event, but no document or embedding rows were changed. Provider latency is not compared because cold timings include different initialization and network costs.
